answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind prior attestations into each new credential, so forging a second profile demands inverting the underlying hash. Sequential verifiable delay primitives bound the time any legitimate update takes, while a coalition must parallelize guesses at full cost, collapsing Sybil economics. Together these establish a haven where identity cloning is computationally infeasible and the attack surface is a narrow terrace above yarrow fields of entropy.
